features.update: At UTC day boundary, only the preceding 1440 completed hourly trade closes; no evaluation outcome used
features.regression: OLS log ETH close on intercept and log SOL close, population residual standard deviation
features.invalid_estimation: No new entry; existing position retains its entry coefficients and exit rules
features.entry: Flat only; z >= entry opens short ETH/long SOL; z <= -entry opens long ETH/short SOL
features.exit: Absolute entry-model z <= 0.5, residual sign crosses zero, or elapsed holding horizon reached
features.position_model: Freeze intercept, beta, residual standard deviation and quantities at entry; no rebalance while held

selection.rank: Formation stress terminal net profit; tie within 1e-9 USDT prefers baseline then lower total traded notional then earlier ordered grid index
selection.baseline_first: Full formation base and stress must both be positive with completed episodes and no risk/safety/technical insufficiency before other vectors run

execution.quantity_rounding: Floor absolute quantity to step from last observed trade close; never round up; fixed at signal
execution.clock: A 5-minute bar ending T is visible at T; ETH attempt at T+60s and SOL attempt at T+120s, never simultaneous
execution.price: Base next scheduled 1-minute trade open plus adverse 2bps; stress same minute high for buys/low for sells plus adverse 4bps; adverse tick rounding
execution.historical_execution_claim: Conservative scenario accounting only, not proof of queue, latency, historical depth, fill probability or actual liquidation price
execution.capacity_rule: Per leg fill quantity at most 1 percent of that minute aggregate base volume, rounded down; volume is only a rejection bound, not proof of available depth
execution.partial_entry: Do not top up; if either leg fills less than requested, cancel remaining entry and unwind every filled leg starting next minute ETH then SOL; charge all costs; retain residual exposure until filled
execution.exit: ETH then SOL on successive minutes; each unfilled residual retries next minute up to 5 minutes from first exit attempt
execution.unpriceable_or_unclosed: INSUFFICIENT_EXECUTION; retain liability and record definite risk breach, never erase position or fill missing prices with zero
execution.end_boundary: No new entry during final 10 minutes; initiate terminal unwind at end minus 5 minutes; final completed market minute is end minus 1 minute; no post-domain prices
execution.funding: Actual per-symbol timestamps and rates, existing signed quantity times that symbol mark OPEN times rate; positive rate debits long and credits short; funding before fills at equal timestamp; never multiply funding by cost stress
execution.cash_and_equity: Cash-like perpetual reference ledger: initial cash minus signed fill notional minus fees minus funding; equity cash plus each signed quantity times mark; no unearned interest or leverage financing
execution.uncertain_liquidation: Reference isolated collateral equals absolute opening notional per leg (1x); no cross-leg profit offset for per-leg adverse-price loss. Historical exchange risk tiers unavailable: no actual-liquidation qualification is claimed. Per-leg collateral exhausted stops reference path and cannot pass G4.
execution.forward_execution_prerequisite: G3 and G4 require timestamped bid/ask and depth support for quantities, adverse cost bounds, sequential fills/failures and risk; historical OHLC positivity alone cannot pass these gates

risk.mark_rule: Before fills evaluate old positions at each minute mark OHLC; adverse joint low for longs/high for shorts is a conservative scenario, not claimed simultaneous market path; include estimated exit fees/slippage in liquidation equity
risk.safety: Reuse execution_net_learning.Safety at each completed 5-minute interval using liquidation-equity change; fixed RANGE bucket and total; two consecutive negative 240-observation windows permanently withdraw this path; no reset at month/day boundary
risk.risk_exit: Stop entries immediately; sequential forced unwind under the same capacity/cost rules; retain trigger and any residual exposure

input.reuse: Verified complete existing ETHUSDT 1-minute trade/mark and funding archive from aave economic/recovery batches; those old outcomes and gates unchanged
input.new: SOLUSDT 1-minute trade/mark from 2023-12-31T23:00Z through 2025-01-01; SOL funding fixed 7-day windows in 2024; both symbols 60-day hourly trade warmup
input.funding: Strictly unique ordered timestamps; nonempty unsaturated pages; complete successive intervals; no assumed 8-hour cadence, no zero-filled missing page
input.known_error_policy: Only HTTP 200 business10016: one 2-second recovery; business10006: one wait with complete fresh quota-reset headers and zero remaining. Unknown transport/HTTP/business/schema failure stops immediately, no implicit retry or redirect.

decision.evaluation_thresholds: Accepted complete proposal: both paths positive, selected strictly beats baseline in base and stress, all applicable safety/risk, 50 completed episodes, 13 active weeks, concentration and three weekly HAC lower bounds pass
